# Lovable Divine-gold-canvas

> Site showcases the Shrivatsa Gold Lakshmi Pendant and related traditional jewellery information for customers seeking ceremonial pieces.

This is a student information project by ATLAS students, not the official Indriya store. Product specifications are presented separately from styling and cultural guidance. Consult the linked official Indriya sources for current prices, availability and customer support. This site does not publish verified offers or customer ratings.

## Main

- [Shrivatsa Gold Lakshmi Pendant | Indriya](https://divine-gold-canvas.lovable.app/lakshmi-pendant): Discover the traditional 22K yellow gold pendant, its specifications, styling and frequently asked questions.

## More

- [Store Locator | Indriya](https://divine-gold-canvas.lovable.app/store-locator): Access official Indriya store information.
- [Traditional Jewellery | Indriya](https://divine-gold-canvas.lovable.app/traditional-jewellery): Traditional jewellery context and the featured Lakshmi pendant.
- [Bridal Jewellery | Indriya](https://divine-gold-canvas.lovable.app/bridal-jewellery): Bridal jewellery context and the featured Lakshmi pendant.
- [Temple Jewellery Guide: Meaning, Designs & Care](https://divine-gold-canvas.lovable.app/temple-jewellery-guide): Meaning, traditional motifs and practical jewellery care guidance.
- [About](https://divine-gold-canvas.lovable.app/about): ATLAS students project authors and product sourcing.
- [Contact](https://divine-gold-canvas.lovable.app/contact): Website project contact and separately identified official Indriya support sources.

Specifications checked 27 October 2026; confirm current purchase details with Indriya.
